name: Inga Kiriku
source: A young man who was born in the finest area of the wealthy A district. He grew up in a wealthy family without any inconveniences. Full of mysterious self-confidence and not afraid to confront people. His dream is to become a popular rock star, even bigger than the legendary rock guitarist ''Mere''. In order to achieve his dream he wants to escape the A district.
